finding: Query = 317 residues with pLDDT>=70. Six significant hits, all 'Eisosome protein 1' (E 1.5e-9 to 5.9e-7); zero PDB100 hits; one noise hit (kinesin, E=6.5). Full-length model returned only the self-hit.

citation: This analysis (Foldseek positive control on AF-Q12405-F1 = LPX1)
claim: The Foldseek pipeline can detect a hydrolase fold when present
finding: LPX1 retrieved its own crystal structure 2Y6V chains A/B/C (E 3e-74 to 1.3e-71) and many 'AB hydrolase-1 domain-containing protein' models (E to 5.8e-78).
confidence: High; establishes the LPX2 null result is not a pipeline failure

finding: Exactly three signature matches: IPR024527 (1-921), Pfam PF12757 Eisosome1 (349-465), PANTHER PTHR28298 (1-921). No IPR029058, no IPR000073, no patatin, no SSF53474, no Gene3D 3.40.50.1820. Zero Active site features, no EC number, no catalytic activity comment. UniProt protein name is 'Uncharacterized protein YKL050C'.
confidence: High; precomputed InterPro matches, not a fresh InterProScan run (EBI job submission was blocked, HTTP 400 rate limit)

citation: This analysis (regex + composition-matched shuffle null, 1000 permutations)
claim: LPX2 has a GxSxG nucleophile elbow
finding: One G-x-S-x-G in 922 aa: GFSQG at 875-879. Shuffle null expects 0.23 (p=0.204). It lies in UniProt disordered region 834-922 with pLDDT 39.5-44.7. PROSITE PS00120 LIPASE_SER pattern: 0 hits in LPX2, 0 in EIS1, 1 in ATG15 (326 IWVTGHSLGG).
confidence: High. Caveat: the identical pentapeptide GFSQG is the catalytic motif of TGL1 at 199-203, so the pentapeptide alone is uninformative; the discriminator is fold context and pLDDT

claim: LPX2 is sequence-related to characterized lipases
finding: LPX2 vs EIS1 = 782, 27.2% identity over 905 columns. Every lipase scored 33-69 (TGL1 69, NTE1 54, TGL4 53, YJU3 49, TGL2 45, PLB1 39, TGL3 37, ATG15 34, LPX1 33, TGL5 33), i.e. background.

claim: What a genuine yeast peroxisomal lipase looks like
finding: Lpx1 crystal structure at 1.9 A shows the complete catalytic triad on a canonical alpha/beta-hydrolase fold with a four-helix cap over the active site.
confidence: High; defines the contrast case LPX2 fails to match

finding: High-content microscopy screen expanded the yeast peroxi-ome by ~40%. This is the single reference attached to the SGD LPX2 gene name and to GO:0005777 (IDA).
confidence: Moderate-high for localization; provides no enzymatic evidence

claim: GO already annotates LPX2 as a lipase
finding: SGD holds exactly 3 GO annotations for LPX2: GO:0005777 peroxisome (manually curated, PMID 36164978), GO:0008150 biological_process unknown, GO:0003674 molecular_function unknown. No lipase MF term exists.
confidence: High. The lipase claim lives only in the SGD free-text description and the gene-name expansion 'Lipase of PeroXisomes'

claim: The EIS1 family is an eisosome family
finding: E-MAP triplet motif analysis identified Eis1 as a new eisosome component. SGD gives EIS1 GO:0032126 eisosome (PMIDs 19269952, 20526336) and GO:0070941 eisosome assembly.
confidence: High for EIS1, not transferable to LPX2 without direct evidence

citation: SGD interaction_details, loci S000001533 and S000004633
claim: LPX2 functions at the eisosome like EIS1
finding: LPX2: 28 physical interactions, 21 of them singleton two-hybrid, zero with any eisosome protein. EIS1: 91 physical interactions including PIL1, LSP1, SEG1, PST2, YGR130C. LPX2 does interact physically with CDC4 and SKP1 (SCF components).
confidence: Moderate; absence of evidence in two-hybrid data is weak, but the contrast with EIS1 is clear

citation: This analysis (SW of each ohnolog against single-copy Eis1 of other yeasts)
claim: LPX2 and EIS1 are functionally equivalent
finding: K. lactis Eis1 (Q6CTI0): vs LPX2 636, vs EIS1 1159. C. glabrata Eis1 (Q6FKB4): vs LPX2 718, vs EIS1 1489. EIS1 retained the ancestral sequence; LPX2 is the diverged ohnolog.
context: S. cerevisiae vs K. lactis, C. glabrata
confidence: Moderate-high; divergence does not by itself specify the new function
